name: AiCan Rec Extension
description: Record a Chrome tab (with optional audio) to WebM via MediaRecorder. Minimal permissions for Chrome Web Store compliance.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src https://devage-api.vercel.app https://ai-can-read.vercel.app
